candidates.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio 发布 computer-using agents GA 与工作流更新
candidates.evidence: Microsoft's May 2026 Copilot Studio update says computer-using agents are generally available and describes workflow, Work IQ, MCP, A2A and voice agent changes.

candidates.title: OpenAI Status 显示 FedRAMP 用户登录问题仍在处理
candidates.evidence: OpenAI Status showed an ongoing identified incident affecting ChatGPT and FedRAMP login for recently logged-out FedRAMP users.

candidates.title: Check Point 把 frontier AI 扫描结果落到安全发布流程
candidates.evidence: Check Point says its Frontier AI Models Readiness Program used large-scale AI-driven code scanning, validation and hardening, with fixes landing in a Jumbo Security Release.

candidates.title: Borealis-5B-IT
candidates.evidence: The model card lists Borealis-5B-IT as an Apache-2.0 audio-language model built with Whisper Large V3, Qwen3-4B and a trained adapter, with vLLM support.

candidates.title: Harness, Scaffold, and the AI Agent Terms Worth Getting Right
candidates.evidence: The article was published on 2026-05-25 and gives working definitions for model, scaffold, harness, agent, context engineering, skills and related terms.

candidates.title: anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins
candidates.evidence: GitHub confirms the repo contents and license; TrendingRepo supplied the 2026-05-26 momentum cue used only as discovery evidence.

candidates.title: Peter Yang: Codex uses browser to test its own work
candidates.evidence: Peter Yang said Codex is very good and especially impressive because it uses the browser to test its own work, while Claude still wins on design and frontend tasks.

candidates.title: Garry Tan: use several frontier models to judge agent skill runs
candidates.evidence: Garry Tan described an eval pattern where an agent asks three frontier models to review the inputs and outputs of a skill file call and rate effectiveness.

candidates.title: Claude Code in Slack elevated errors resolved
candidates.evidence: Claude Status lists a May 26 incident for elevated errors in Claude Code in Slack, investigated at 01:56 UTC and resolved at 05:19 UTC.
